arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[[{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:14}|%|]{/c}
{/if}Activate three times to attach chains to each of your weapons and perform an attack:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} First, your Two-Handed Bludgeoning weapon slams into the ground, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_BLUNT}{/c} damage and Stunning enemies for {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} seconds.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Next, your Two-Handed Slashing weapon swipes in front of you, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_SLASH}{/c} damage and inflicting {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_SLASH_BLEED}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_SLASH_BLEED}{/c} seconds.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Finally, your Dual Wield weapons swing around you, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_DUALWIELDING}{/c} damage per hit.

Each attack gains an additional effect:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Two Handed Bludgeoning creates a {c_important}{u}Earthquake{/u}{/c} that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_EARTHQUAKE_TOOLTIP}{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[PowerTag.Barbarian_Earthquake."Script Formula 1"]{/c} seconds, 
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Two-Handed Slashing shoots {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c} dealing {c_number}{payload:SHRAPNEL_DAMAGE}{/c} damage inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_A_BLEED_DOT}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_BLEED_DOT}{/c} seconds
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Dual Wield forms {c_important}{u}Dust Devils{/u}{/c} that each deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DUSTDEVIL_DMG_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Iron Maelstrom{/c} now has {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} Charges and it always uses the same attack that matches your last used weapon at {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
Depending on your last used weapon, {c_important}Iron Maelstrom{/c} is now also a single {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skill, and its Cooldown is reduced to {c_number}[{SF_30}]{/c} seconds.
Enemies damaged by {c_important}Iron Maelstrom{/c} {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_36}]{/c} seconds.

Each attack gains an additional effect:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Two Handed Bludgeoning deals {c_number}[SF_31 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Two Handed Slashing deals {c_number}[SF_32 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Dual Wield gains {c_number}[SF_33 * 100|%+|]{/c} Cast Speed.
Weapon swaps reduce the Cooldown of {c_important}Iron Maelstrom{/c} is by {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} second.
Activating {c_important}Iron Maelstrom{/c} reduces all other active Cooldowns by {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} seconds.
